risks.riskTitle: Authenticated buyer checkout writes restaurant orders but buyer orders listener reads user orders
risks.whyItIsRisky: submitShopCheckout writes the order to restaurants/{cart.restaurantId}/orders, while startOrdersListener reads users/{uid}/orders for non-restaurant authenticated users.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A signed-in customer can submit an order and then not see it, or see an incomplete orders list.

risks.riskTitle: Guest order recovery reads orderLookup docs not written by checkout path
risks.whyItIsRisky: Guest recovery loads restaurants/{restaurantId}/orderLookup/{lookupToken}, but the audited checkout path writes restaurants/{restaurantId}/orders and local lookup entries, not the orderLookup document.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A guest order appears immediately after submit but disappears or cannot be recovered after reload.

risks.riskTitle: Checkout trusts persisted cart restaurant and table context at write time
risks.whyItIsRisky: The order write target is built from the normalized persisted cart, not from a final verified active profile/menu/table route context.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A user can submit an order to the wrong restaurant or table after navigating between public menus or QR links.

risks.riskTitle: Header cart shows global cart count while browsing another business
risks.whyItIsRisky: The header count is based on all cart items, while profile cart rendering is restaurant-scoped.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A cart badge can appear on Business B while the cart belongs to Business A.

risks.riskTitle: Public slug route can seed profile/menu before canonical restaurant id is resolved
risks.whyItIsRisky: Initial route state can carry the slug/alias while public route cache and Firestore canonical resolution are asynchronous.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A public profile or menu can briefly or persistently load under a slug/alias instead of the canonical restaurant id.

risks.riskTitle: Public bootstrap cache can seed stale business route payload
risks.whyItIsRisky: The inline/bootstrap path can hydrate route payload, profile preview, feed, stories, and menu shell before current Firestore validation completes.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A visitor can see outdated business/profile/menu preview data on a public route.

risks.riskTitle: Menu state can be loaded from multiple truth sources and caches
risks.whyItIsRisky: Menu can come from public menu doc, menuItems collection, legacy restaurant doc, memory cache, persistent cache, or route seed. A stale accepted source would show the wrong menu.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A public menu displays old items or items from another restaurant.

risks.riskTitle: Table QR runtime reads meta by profile.restaurantId only
risks.whyItIsRisky: The verified QR state loader uses profile.restaurantId; profiles that only have canonicalRestaurantId or a slug alias can miss or mis-scope QR meta.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A QR menu can show missing or wrong table QR availability/configuration.

risks.riskTitle: Chat thread listener starts on authenticated V1 routes
risks.whyItIsRisky: Chat is not V1, but authenticated startup calls startChatThreadsListener globally.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: V1 routes perform chat Firestore reads and can show/update chat badges even when chat is out of scope.

risks.riskTitle: Notifications listener and push sync start from authenticated core path
risks.whyItIsRisky: Authenticated startup loads notifications and calls syncNotificationsPushRuntime, which can start notification listeners and badge updates on V1 routes.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: V1 surfaces can show badge changes or do notification Firebase work unrelated to the current route.

risks.riskTitle: Search can show cached restaurant truth before current network truth
risks.whyItIsRisky: Restaurant data is loaded through local cache and network reconciliation; search results are derived from the shared restaurant list.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Search displays a business name, location, slug, or availability that is no longer current.

risks.riskTitle: Map selected business can become stale after restaurant data refresh
risks.whyItIsRisky: selectedBusiness is a retained object while businessLocations can be replaced by cache/network loads.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: The map detail panel can show a business that no longer matches the current marker/list data.

risks.riskTitle: Feed gate location localStorage can stale-filter feed/search/map context
risks.whyItIsRisky: Viewer location/city is local persisted state and not scoped by user or route in the audited code.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A user sees feed/search/map context for an old city/location.

risks.riskTitle: Menu meta listener can update menu badge after menu surface changes
risks.whyItIsRisky: The listener is scoped by restaurantId and writes menu badge state from realtime meta; cleanup timing is important during route changes.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A menu badge/status can belong to a previous restaurant.

risks.riskTitle: Profile listener can alter header/profile data globally after auth startup
risks.whyItIsRisky: Current user/business profile listener runs globally for authenticated sessions and can change owner/admin context while on public V1 routes.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Header profile icon or owner state changes unexpectedly while browsing a public business/menu route.

risks.riskTitle: Owner/admin public menu and focus writes share public docs used by V1 guests
risks.whyItIsRisky: Owner/admin writes directly update public menu/meta/offers docs read by public menu, QR menu, and cart/order flows.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A public visitor can see an unintended menu/focus/status change if the owner/admin write uses the wrong restaurant id.

risks.riskTitle: CRM customer and lead writes can change public restaurant truth
risks.whyItIsRisky: CRM customer/lead flows write restaurant and lead documents that also feed search/map/profile truth.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Public/search/map business data changes because stale admin CRM state wrote to the wrong restaurant/customer.

risks.riskTitle: Social engagement listeners can update stale post or menu detail state
risks.exactVariableOrState: modal post doc unsubscribe, menu detail doc unsubscribe
risks.whyItIsRisky: Post/menu item detail listeners write live metadata and depend on modal/detail cleanup to avoid stale updates.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Post or menu detail social counts belong to a previously opened item.

risks.riskTitle: Waiter order status update depends on resolved restaurant context
risks.whyItIsRisky: The waiter app can update order status in restaurants/{restaurantId}/orders; wrong restaurant resolution would mutate the wrong order path.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A waiter marks the wrong restaurant's order as accepted/preparing/ready/done.

risks.riskTitle: Firebase Functions and notification paths remain reachable from V1 core startup
risks.exactFunction: getFunctions lazy runtime / notification runtime wiring
risks.whyItIsRisky: Functions/notification code is wired into the social app core even though V1 prioritizes website/menu/cart/orders correctness.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: V1 routes can spend startup work on notification/function concerns or show notification side effects.
